expected_findings.root_cause: __aexit__ delegates to __exit__ with None for the exception type, value and traceback instead of forwarding the arguments it received
expected_findings.failure_path: an exception raised inside `async with attempt:` reaches __aexit__, which calls __exit__ with (None, None, None); __exit__ takes its success branch, records no failed outcome and returns None, so the exception propagates out of the async with and past the retry loop: the attempt is never recorded as failed and no retry happens
